item.name: Revote of a non-tied round refused (fail closed: 400)

exec: pm.test('Revote: refusal says the round is not tied', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('not tied'));

item.name: Revote of a tied revote-rule round permitted once (happy: 201)

exec: pm.test('Revote: first revote of the tied round created (201)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('Revote: new round links the tied round via revoteOfRound', () => pm.expect(b.revoteOfRound).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vrTiedRevoteRoundId')));

item.name: Second revote of the same tied round refused (once-guard: 400)

exec: pm.test('Revote: refusal cites the single-revote guarantee', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('already been revoted'));

item.name: Seed ACTIVE proxy 1 for the holder
Seed ACTIVE proxy 2 for the holder
Third proxy for the same holder rejected at the default cap of 2 (error: 422)

exec: pm.test('Proxy cap: third proxy for the holder rejected (422)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Proxy cap: rejection says the maximum is reached', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Maximum number of proxies reached'));

item.name: Proxy for a different holder still registers under the cap (happy: 201)

exec: pm.test('Proxy cap: under-cap holder registers (201)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('Proxy cap: fresh proxy starts pending-approval', () => pm.expect(b.proxyStatus).to.eql('pending-approval'));

item.name: Cast vote stamps castAs from the participant attendance mode (remote)

exec: pm.test('castAs: remote participantType is stamped on the vote', () => pm.expect(b.castAs).to.eql('remote'));
